title: The next Career Maniacs
question: My recommendation is Built for the big moment: a distinctive ocean identity with the coaching offer immediately clear. Choose a direction, or tell me to make the call.

options.label: Built for the big moment
options.lineage: Coastal performance brands and surf outfitter campaigns
options.thesis: A serious coaching practice with the confidence and scale of a performance brand.
options.viewport: A short, oversized promise beside open water; one gold call button, then a concrete storytelling example.
options.risk: The ocean must support the coaching offer, never turn the site into a surf shop.

options.label: The living horizon
options.thesis: The ocean moves quietly behind one clear offer and a guided story.
options.case: Strong continuity with the wave identity; weaker clarity if motion competes with the coaching.
options.viewport: Full-screen water, a compact heading on the left, and a clear action above the horizon.
options.risk: More GPU work and greater readability risk than photographic panels.

options.label: Make your story heard
options.thesis: Architectural lettering turns the coaching message into an unmistakable public statement.
options.case: Clear and memorable; its loudness may feel less personal to a skeptical executive.
options.viewport: An enormous short headline, tight navigation, and the coaching offer presented like a performance bill.
options.risk: Aggressive typography can overwhelm the human side of coaching.

options.label: The working playbook
options.thesis: Coaching presented as a practical working kit, with emphatic labels and purposeful contrast.
options.case: Concrete and direct, but fashion labels and hazard marks distract from the actual method.
options.viewport: A compact bold headline and literal program navigation, with Jeff and the work plainly visible.
options.risk: Can read as a merchandise brand rather than a coaching relationship.

canonCard.label: Classic executive coaching
canonCard.thesis: A familiar professional coaching website, carefully executed.
canonCard.viewport: Jeff’s portrait beside a straightforward coaching headline, then services and testimonials.
canonCard.risk: Clear, but less distinctive as a Maniacs identity.
